$comment: Dependency architecture policy for scripts/quality/audit_dependencies.py. Gate G5. The rule is simple and deliberately strict: a library may depend only on libraries in a strictly lower layer. Same-layer edges are refused too, because they are how cycles start.

layers.name: base
layers.description: Logging, error results, byte streams, string and path helpers, threads; depends on the standard library and zlib only.

layers.name: core
layers.description: Numerics, transport primitives (TCP, UDP and serial transports among them) and figures as display lists (mne_scene), built only on the base library or on the standard library alone.

layers.name: support
layers.description: Cross-cutting services used by everything above: the Python bridge, HTML reports and the Lab Streaming Layer on the transports of mne_com.

layers.name: io
layers.description: File formats, machine learning back-ends and self-contained toolkits built directly on the primitives.

layers.name: model
layers.description: Domain models and format bridges assembled from the I/O layer, and the toolkit-independent view models of the viewers (mne_viewmodels).

layers.name: acquisition
layers.description: Bridges of the standard-C++ acquisition core to FIFF, BIDS and LSL (measurement-info conversion, recording, the lsl:// source), the EEG amplifier sources with their simulators, and the Polhemus digitiser.

layers.name: analysis
layers.description: Estimators that consume the forward solution.

layers.name: processing
layers.description: Signal processing pipelines that orchestrate the analysis layer.

layers.name: visualization3d
layers.description: Three-dimensional display, the top of the stack.

$variable_prefixes_comment: Variables that hold bare Qt module names; the namespace is prepended at the point of use with list(TRANSFORM), which the audit does not evaluate.
$qt_layers_comment: The only layers whose libraries may link Qt (DEP022). Every other library builds and installs without Qt (MNE_BUILD_QT=OFF).
$allowed_external_comment: Third-party targets the libraries are permitted to link. Qt targets are normalised to a version-independent Qt:: spelling. Adding an entry here is an architectural decision and should be reviewed as one.

$exception_schema.$comment: Required shape of every entry in 'exceptions'. An exception is a dated promise: it must name the edge, an owner, a rationale, and an expiry date. Expired exceptions fail the audit, and exceptions for edges that no longer exist are reported as stale so they cannot accumulate.
$exception_schema.rationale: why the layering cannot be honoured yet
